title: Form completion #7
topic: Coach tour booking · Gym membership · Evening course enrolment · Lost property report
context:
Narrator: Conversation 1. Coach tour booking.
Grace: Highland Day Tours, Grace speaking.
Caller: Hi, I'd like to book a place on the castle tour.
Grace: Can I take your surname, please?
Caller: It's Hargreaves. That's H, A, R, G, R, E, A, V, E, S.
Grace: How many people will be coming?
Caller: Seven, I think.
Grace: What's your postcode?
Caller: L N six, five J G.
Grace: Which date would you like to travel?
Caller: The eighteenth of November... no, sorry, that's a Sunday. Make it the seventeenth of November.
Grace: Let me give you your reference. Have you got a pen?
Caller: Yes, go ahead.
Grace: It's H D five two eight nine.
Grace: Lovely, that's everything. Thank you.
Narrator: Conversation 2. Gym membership.
Sam: Good morning, Riverside Fitness, Sam speaking.
Caller: Hello, I'd like to join the gym, please.
Sam: How many classes a week do you think you will come to?
Caller: Three, I think.
Sam: Let me give you your reference. Have you got a pen?
Caller: Yes, go ahead.
Sam: It's F G nine one six nine.
Sam: What's your postcode?
Caller: N H two, nine B L.
Sam: And what's the best number to reach you on?
Caller: It's oh seven oh, one one five one, two three three three.
Caller: How much is the joining fee?
Sam: It's thirty pounds... oh, hold on, that's last year's price. This year it's forty pounds.
Sam: Lovely, that's everything. Thank you.
Narrator: Conversation 3. Evening course enrolment.
Priya: Parkside College, Priya speaking.
Caller: Hello, I'd like to enrol on an evening photography course.
Priya: What's your postcode?
Caller: B G eight, five W K.
Priya: Let me give you your reference. Have you got a pen?
Caller: Yes, go ahead.
Priya: It's C D eight nine zero five.
Priya: The next course begins soon. Which date is the first class?
Caller: The sixth of April, please.
Priya: How many weeks does the course run for?
Caller: Six, I think. Actually, let me say five, it's better to be safe.
Priya: Can I take your surname, please?
Caller: It's Sutcliffe. That's S, U, T, C, L, I, F, F, E.
Priya: Lovely, that's everything. Thank you.
Narrator: Conversation 4. Lost property report.
Mark: Central Station lost property, Mark speaking.
Caller: Hello, I think I left my rucksack on a train yesterday.
Mark: Let me give you your reference. Have you got a pen?
Caller: Yes, go ahead.
Mark: It's X G two eight six zero.
Mark: And what's the best number to reach you on?
Caller: It's oh seven seven, oh nine seven four, four oh one oh.
Mark: What's your postcode?
Caller: W C nine, one N M.
Caller: How much is the handling charge?
Mark: It's thirty-five pounds.
Mark: On which date did you lose it?
Caller: The sixth of May... no, sorry, that's a Sunday. Make it the fifth of May.
Mark: Lovely, that's everything. Thank you.
